const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd:"python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('pagination.py')
s = p.read_text()
old = '    actual_limit = limit or DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE\n'
new = '    actual_limit = DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE if limit is None else limit\n'
assert s.count(old) == 1
p.write_text(s.replace(old, new))
p = Path('public_tests.py')
s = p.read_text()
marker = '    def test_positive_limit_and_offset(self):\n'
new_test = '    def test_explicit_zero_limit_returns_empty_list(self):\n        self.assertEqual(paginate(["a", "b", "c"], limit=0), [])\n\n'
assert s.count(marker) == 1
p.write_text(s.replace(marker, new_test + marker))
PY",workdir:"/tmp/delegation-recovery-runs/q613/workspace",yield_time_ms:10000,max_output_tokens:1000});
